item.title: Number Line Addition Practice to 10: No Prep Printable Worksheets
item.description: No prep addition practice for beginners. Children start with picture sums and move on to adding with a number line from 0 to 10. 160 sums in total, with an answer key so a child can check their own work. For kindergarten, first grade and homeschool maths.
